title: Marketplace screenshot + diagram inventory (AWS/GCP) — refresh 2025
content:
Last updated: 2025-02-06 (Soojin)

Purpose
- Single inventory of all screenshots/diagrams needed for AWS Marketplace + GCP Cloud Marketplace listings and the attached Security Packet.
- Track owner, status, redaction requirements, and where each asset is used.
- This is the “source of truth” for DES-212 and the listing submissions.

Status legend
- NEEDS UPDATE: asset exists but outdated UI/copy/flows
- IN PROGRESS: being captured/edited
- REDACTION NEEDED: capture done but requires blur/cleanup/approval
- IN REVIEW (SEC/LEGAL): waiting on security/legal review
- APPROVED: ready to upload to AWS/GCP listing + internal archive

Redaction checklist (apply unless explicitly marked “none”)
- Remove/blur: customer names, org IDs, API keys, email addresses, billing amounts, internal environment URLs, Slack channels, internal feature flags.
- Use “Example Org” + synthetic usage data.
- Region names: OK to show cloud regions, but avoid implying availability unless confirmed by Partnerships.
- Console screenshots must be from “marketplace-buyer” staging tenant (ask Chloe/Leila).

Capture guidelines
- Resolution: 1920×1080 PNG (preferred), avoid JPEG compression artifacts.
- UI state: stable; no transient toasts unless the toast message is the point.
- Use current branding and “Redwood Inference” naming (no legacy “Redwood AI”).
- If showing graphs: use seeded synthetic data set “demo-seed-v3” (Leila).

Required counts (for submission planning)
- AWS Marketplace: target 6–8 gallery images + 1 hero image + 1–2 optional attachments (security packet PDF handled separately).
- GCP Marketplace: typically fewer images; ensure ‘How to deploy’ screenshots are current and match step-by-step text.

Open questions / decisions needed
1) Do we show the “model catalog” page (A2 variant) or “usage analytics” page (A7) as the primary Hosted screenshot? (PMM leaning A2; Sales likes A7.)
2) Dedicated vs Private: do we include one screenshot each in the main listing gallery, or create separate listing variants/pages? (Pending Partnerships guidance.)
3) Confirm final headline/tagline so A1/A15 can be finished.

Next actions (week of 2025-02-10)
- Chloe + Leila: deliver A3–A5 updated captures from staging tenant (marketplace-buyer) and hand off for redaction.
- Marcus + Olga: finalize review notes on A9/A12 and mark ‘approved’ or request edits.
- Dev: reproduce GCP region mismatch error post-fix and capture A17 with final copy.
- Soojin: lock down final gallery order and send to Partnerships for pre-review.

Storage conventions
- Final assets (approved): shared_drives/go-to-market/marketplace-assets/final/YYYY-MM/
- Working edits: shared_drives/go-to-market/marketplace-assets/working/
- Redaction source files (restricted): shared_drives/security-and-compliance/marketplace-assets-restricted/

Notes to self (PMM)
- Don’t use the word “HIPAA compliant” anywhere in imagery unless legal explicitly approves.
- Ensure every screenshot that mentions “Dedicated” / “Private” uses the same SKU names as the marketplace SKU catalog v2.
